prior_findings.title: Numeric bound documentation temporarily stale
prior_findings.scenario: A reader consults docs/agents/review-agent.md after this merge and finds '128 KiB of captured change material, 10,000 changed lines' while the deployed policy enforces 1 MiB / 30,000 lines.
prior_findings.impact: Documentation-only drift for the window between this merge and the announced follow-up control PR; no runtime or enforcement impact.
evidence: docs/agents/review-agent.md:124-125 still states 128 KiB / 10,000 changed lines
PR body bootstrap-boundary section states the numeric documentation update ships with the follow-up Context-bound control PR
prior_findings.resolution: Land the announced follow-up control PR that raises the Context bound and updates docs/agents/review-agent.md and the schema contract test numbers together.
